name: js-yaml
license_evidence: https://registry.npmjs.org/js-yaml/5.5.0 (license field) and the LICENSE file in the pinned tarball, compared byte for byte with the installed copy in the image
input_api: load(text) with the default CORE_SCHEMA after strict UTF-8 decoding of a local Buffer; YAMLException rejects the input; the returned value is mapped to the Parsarium typed YAML tree
documentation_evidence: The pinned README Usage section shows load('greeting: hello') and docs/usage.md documents load(string[, options]) as parsing one YAML document; the bundled dist/js-yaml.cjs.js load() doc comment says it throws on multi-document or empty sources and that the default schema is CORE_SCHEMA without the merge tag.
scope: One complete YAML document from local bytes decoded as strict UTF-8 and passed to load(text) with default options (CORE_SCHEMA). The adapter maps the returned plain objects, arrays and scalars to the Parsarium typed tree in key insertion order; aliases are expanded by the loader. JavaScript numbers do not keep YAML's int/float distinction: a finite integral number is typed int. Object key order follows JavaScript property order, which matches source order for the controls' non-integer keys.
family_note: js-yaml 5.5.0 ships one bundled dist/js-yaml.cjs.js containing its own YAML 1.2 event parser (parseEvents) and constructor (constructFromEvents). The adapter calls the documented load(); no other YAML package is involved and the only runtime dependency, argparse, serves the CLI. yaml-ast-parser and @stoplight/yaml are forks of js-yaml 3.x and share its lineage; eemeli/yaml is a separate implementation.
verification_note: Both valid schema-neutral YAML 1.2 controls give exact typed trees equal to the hand-written expected trees in controls/yaml/check_controls.py (cross-checked there with Ruby Psych/libyaml). The controls avoid integral-valued floats and integer-like keys, so the JavaScript number and key-order limits cannot change the result. They do not test tags, merge keys, multi-document streams, YAML 1.1-only scalars or malformed input.
